description: What the Omarchy Quattro shell host injects into lunana plugins, and the host surfaces lunana depends on. Pinned so a host change that breaks these is caught, not discovered at runtime (Shibumi-inspired).

pinnedHost.note: Validated live on this version. Re-pin and re-verify before claiming support for another.

ipc.note: Functions must declare a return type, e.g. function toggle(): void.

hostSurfacesUsed.theme: qs.Commons Color (bar.background, bar.text, bar.active, background, foreground) and Style (font.family, duration).
hostSurfacesUsed.compositor: Quickshell.Hyprland (monitorFor, focusedMonitor, workspaces, toplevels) and Quickshell.Wayland (ToplevelManager.activeToplevel).
hostSurfacesUsed.selection: shell.json bar.id selects the active kind:bar plugin; empty/absent falls back to omarchy.bar.
hostSurfacesUsed.enablement: Non-bar third-party plugins default to disabled; enabled via omarchy-plugin-enable.
